name: Business License Tax
notes: An annual tax for the privilege of doing business in the city, measured by the code's employee schedule or by dwelling units, not by gross receipts, except for the reduced schedule when gross income is between $1,000 and $2,500. Amounts below are the amounts printed in chapter 5.12. They are not the community services and facilities tax in chapter 3.06, which the city may bill on the same license. Section 5.12.060 caps the total under section 5.12.010 at $500 for one location, and the total under the apartment, hotel, and trailer-park sections at $350. Section 5.12.070 lets the council increase the fees after a 10% rise in the San Francisco Bay Area CPI; no resolution adopting an increase was opened. Home occupations at or under $1,000 of gross receipts are sent to section 5.16.010, which was not opened. Revenue collected was not in a document opened for this record.
